links.outcome: Decision accuracy in simulated CPR with clinician-supervised vs autonomous ChatGPT vs paper guide
links.effect: Supervised-ChatGPT group showed significantly higher decision accuracy than paper guide and ChatGPT groups, though scenario completion time was longer. In one instance ChatGPT suggested a risky option.
links.quote: Results indicate that the Supervised-ChatGPT group showed significantly higher decision accuracy compared to the paper guide and ChatGPT groups, although the scenario completion time was longer.
